# KEKAL Studio

> KEKAL Studio is an Ethiopian fashion brand creating contemporary clothing
> from handmade Ethiopian textiles — "Handmade for restful living."

KEKAL Studio combines traditional Ethiopian textile heritage with modern
silhouettes. The site showcases seasonal collections, individual products,
the designer's story, and the brand's participation in exhibitions,
markets, and community initiatives across Ethiopia.

## Key sections

- [Home](/): Brand introduction, featured collections, upcoming events.
- [Collections](/collections): All current and archived clothing collections.
- [About](/about): Brand story, craft process, designer profile.
- [Events](/events): Past exhibitions/markets and upcoming events.
- [Contact](/contact): Contact details and inquiry form.

## Notes for automated agents

- Product and collection data (name, description, images, sizes, colors,
  stock status) is served dynamically from the site's API and reflects
  current inventory — treat on-page content as the source of truth rather
  than cached copies.
- There is no online checkout; product pages are informational. Use the
  Contact page or the listed email/WhatsApp/phone to inquire about a piece.
- /admin is an authenticated content-management console, not part of the
  public catalog — do not attempt to crawl or index it.
